notes:
REF-BM-03: Title and description can be edited only after saving, not before.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry uses plain text fields with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL but omits notes.
REF-BM-14: No #tag search syntax is implemented.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is unsupported.
REF-BM-17: Bookmarks have no unread/read-later state.
REF-BM-18: No separate unread-bookmark view exists.
REF-BM-19: No action marks an unread bookmark as read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions are implemented.
REF-BM-21: No current-filter whole-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Results are hard-coded to newest-first; users cannot choose a sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes are stored and displayed as escaped plain text, without Markdown rendering.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot preservation is implemented.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support is implemented.
REF-BM-26: No bookmark archive state or default-list exclusion exists.
REF-BM-27: Only permanent deletion exists; reversible archiving does not.
REF-BM-28: No separate archived-bookmark view exists.
REF-BM-29: Bundles and reusable saved filters are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are implemented.
